reviews.comment: You won't find a professor who will make you feel more seen and respected than Professor Mccormack. She's an expert, yes, but also so much more. She made college comfortable, after 4 miserable years. Her feedback is positive and constructive. She impacted my life more than I thought possible, and I will forever be grateful for her kindness.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is quite literally the best professor I have ever had. Her knowledge is beyond amazing and she truly knows how to teach while having fun with it. The class is challenging and you have to put in the work to get an A, but the feedback she provides is beyond helpful and she truly cares about her students. I would take this class 1000x over!

Professor McCormack is unlike any other professor I've had at the Bush School. She has firsthand experience working internationally and her knowledge reflects it in lecture. Class has unique activities that seem odd at first, but are practical in nature and you will not forget anything. Very upsetting to hear that her contract didn't get renewed.
Fascinating lectures. Accessible Office hours. Subject matter expert. Recommend the class to all students interested in foreign policy. I hope she teaches more classes at the Bush School.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: First time my tuition has been well invested in four years. Incredible class that gave me insight equivalent to 10 years in the field I'm sure. Literally the only good professor in the department, makes everyone else look even worse. The activities seem crazy at first, but they stick in your mind and you won't forget what you learn.

A real gem of a professor, but needs to offer more classes because this is the best learning environment I've had in college full stop. Today she sat with me for an hour and explained Middle East political history from the Persians onward, from her own memory. And when I checked something? Completely precisely accurate. She is so well informed.

It's 10pm and I just left, she was still happy to explain concepts and complex foreign policy issues a whole 11 hours after she started office hours. Knowledgeable and caring, her classes are funny and have so much practical real world understanding you won't get in any other part of your degree. Best at Bush, and an absolute Aggie treasure.

Probably the best poli sci professor I've had at A&M. Her lectures are fascinating and engaging; almost every week there was some game or fun activity related to material content. She is very flexible with deadlines, I had a rough semester and she told me to prioritize my work/mental health, not her class. Assignments actually make you learn.

Professor McCormack is probably the best professor I have had throughout all of college. She will work with you on any questions or concerns you have, and actually understands that you have more going on than just her class. Her lectures are super interesting and include many activities. Would take any class that she offers if she had more!

Professor Mccormack really cares about you. For the first time in four years, I feel like my wellbeing, progress and future actually matters to my professor and it's a great feeling. Very considerate, thoughtful about your needs and feelings, and has so much experience in foreign policy and security that she shares to help you learn.

The most feedback you will ever get, clear explanations and fast. High standards but has resources and teaches to get you there. GDrive is a goldmine and I wish I had her as a freshman because college would be a breeze. I prefer her slides over Geva, so if you're in his section email her. She's also very sweet and will help you out if you're sick.

Most difficult class at A&M and a lot of people drop. But if your genuinely interested, willing to work and communicate this is also the best class. The feedback provided was something else. It was quick, specific, and detailed - and she cares, she made sure my post-graduation plans were good and checks in on student mental health regularly

Maisie was the most impactful professor I've ever had. She is reassuring and so smart on foreign policy and even if you really mess up she comes to save you at the last second. She's also super humble. I googled her and found all the projects she does around the world and am even more impressed she makes so much time for her students

Followed up when I stopped attending when my mental health was not good, and didnt stop even when I didnt reply. Even though it took me a semester to get back to her, she responded right away and helped me navigate starting over. Professor Mccormack is sweet and I really really appreciate her being there for me every time things go bad

Had connections, helped me figure out what paperwork I needed for MCBQ. She is a good professor to take if you are in the corps because she has a lot of time and respect. Flexible if you have commitments with your unit. Unlike most professors doesnt hate the military..
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Connected with everyone individually from day one which wasnt what I expected college to be like at all. She has a google resource that has everything you could ever need to do good. On the first day she gave us Aggie bracelets he made herself! I won a Kindle for participation and everyone got care packages. Ask her about the murder orange!!

Translates papers into being easy to understand. It sounds simple but this is her literal superpower, I even asked about papers from other classes to get help and in five minutes she made it so much easier
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She wont bump your B into an A, but will help you earn it. If you rely on a curve, this isnt the professor for you. BUT when it comes to understanding the content clearly and actually knowing what is happening in foreign policy this is your girl. Records lectures and has paragraph to paragraph templates for the papers
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The hardest class Ive ever taken. I was lazy and didnt look at the google drive a month into the semester. Dont do that take time to look at every file before classes start. Everything you need to get an A and also actually understand/use the content outside of class is there. She filled in for Geva and knows a LOT about terrorism
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Delivered groceries and medicine to me when I had COVID. She also made up a care package for me to keep me from being miserable and let me zoom with her when I couldnt take carantine anymore

Saved my grade. She explains concepts and works through complex readings so you can understand. Her quizzes are designed to help you get extra credit and she brought me from a low D to an A.. very available so work with her at the start and save yourself a stressful semester

She actually seems sad when she has to give you a low grade, and even though she gave a bunch of feedback, still emailed me to explain exactly how I could do better and strategically work to get an A. I found her slides easier to follow than Geva, and shes really approachable.

Any professor who turns up wearing Gucci and tells stories about dumb things they did in war zones is a must take class. Just do it. The work isnt hard, shes flexible if you communicate, and is genuinely one of the most fascinating people you will ever meet.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Entertaining professor. Can roast you and herself. Made me excited to go to class every time. She knows a lot about military tech and US military in general which is cool and kinda unexpected

Dont even have my grade yet but just want to say that she left so much feedback on my paper. 46 comments across 20 pages No other class will get you so much specific and constructive help. If you want to learn to write find a section with Maisie. Extremely helpful throughout the whole class project + makes everything interesting.

Heard what some students did to her this week: bad bull. Maisie provides excellent feedback. Worth your time to look around the Google files she sets up. If you use them its almost impossible to get less than an A. On top of being very knowledgeble and experienced she is hilarious and essentially just a good person.

A friend of mine was in a class with her where 3 students were objectifying Dr Mccormack. Disgusted to hear this. I graduated last semester but took her for Foreign Policy. She is the kindest, most supportive professor. Honestly the best teacher I ever had. Fix your schedule to take her class IF you are mature enough to be respectful!

Great person, great professor. Genius vibes, can tell you the news before its on tv, she will also go bat for you when things are tough with school or life. Today some students made inappropriate comments and I was ashamed to be in a class with them. She stayed classy and calm. Will look to take other classes with her for sure.

Some fellow aggies asked Professor Mccormack inapropriate questions on zoom today. No teacher is less deserving of being disrespected. She cares about students, creates so many resources for us, and has hilarious stories she uses as useful examples. I want her to know how grateful I am to her. I should have done something earlier to stop it.

I don't know who to email to tell them what maisie brings to our school so I'm doing this review. I was stressed out over finding a job because I graduate in a few months and she helped me change my resume, did hours of interview practice then sent my resume to her friend in my dream agency. I got the job offer today. She's amazing!!

Easy enought class (tons of extra credit from both professors) so you can meet the most interesting professor/instructor/whatever at A&M but she's also down to earth and remembers how it is to be a college student. I wish she taught more courses, or she could start a podcast. Guaranteed to change the way you see the world.

Amazing. Wicked smart, funny, generous with her time and expertise. My father had his own questions after I told him about some of the material shes helping me with this summer and even had a zoom call with her! Shes his favorite professor too
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: So I loved Dr McCormack during the class. She's the most invested professor and does anything to help students succeed (like beyond what I have ever seen at A&M). But this morning I got a job I never thought was possible entirely thanks to her and now she has god status. Y'all better treat this girl right

She made sure we had groceries and clean water and blankets during snowpocalypse with no expectation back. Will accommodate any problem in life you have and knows your health not your class work is most important. Think of her as a smol British version of Roblyer. Love the accent

Tough assignments but gives you everything you need to get over 100% (extra credit too). Maisie is one of those instructors who is just super passionate and you end up invested in the topic like its infectious. She is super clear, really invested in her students and a fun mix with Professor Geva in class. Take any class with her!!

Dr Mccormack basically saved my whole semester and made me much more confident with my writing. Feedback was always extremely helpful and encouraging, really constructive and in-depth. She cares about you and will help with class or things outside of school even if it takes all her time. Dr Mccormack is the best person on campus!

Maisie is a wonderful and caring TA. She has helped me a lot in POLS 439. She has been the best TA I have ever had in my undergrad. She will go out of her way to make you feel better about yourself and will help you along the semester with any questions you might have. She is down to earth and has a lot of knowledge on international countries.

She spent all day emailing me back today after I realized my computer wasn't working. She responded so fast every time and I was really strssed. She was super reassuring and worked out a solution for me and even my other classes. I know it's the start of the semester but I was considering dropping this class and definitely won't now
